quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to bring along an outfit made for running and jumping"?
quests.question: Pack Your Gym Clothes
quests.hint: Sneakers and comfy, stretchy clothes go inside your bag for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack gym clothes for an active class full of running and games.
quests.funFact: Comfy sneakers help protect your feet while you run, jump, and play games at school!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to give outdoor flowers and vegetables a good drink"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: This is for plants growing outside in the ground, not in small pots indoors.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the garden so outdoor plants can grow big and healthy.
quests.funFact: Watering a garden in the cool of the evening helps plants soak up water before the hot sun returns!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to pair up clean socks after they come out of the wash"?
quests.question: Match Your Socks
quests.hint: This is a matching puzzle you solve with clean laundry.
quests.explanation: Yes! We match socks together after they come out of the laundry.
quests.funFact: Matching socks is like a fun little puzzle you solve with clean laundry!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to carry the full bin outside for collection"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: A bag or bin gets carried outside for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We empty the trash once the bin at home gets full.
quests.funFact: Taking out the trash regularly helps keep germs and odors away from your home!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to find two socks that look exactly the same"?
quests.question: Match Your Socks
quests.hint: You do this after laundry is washed and dried.
quests.explanation: That's right! Matching socks means finding two that look exactly the same.
quests.funFact: Some families keep a special basket just for socks that are still looking for their pair!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to suck up dust and crumbs from the carpet"?
quests.question: Vacuum the Floor
quests.hint: This machine makes a humming sound as it cleans.
quests.explanation: Yes! We vacuum the floor to clean dust and crumbs from the carpet.
quests.funFact: The very first vacuum cleaners were much bigger and louder than the ones we use today!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to water the plants growing outside in the ground"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: A hose or a watering can helps with this outdoor task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watering the garden means giving outdoor flowers and vegetables a good drink.
quests.funFact: Gardens can grow colorful flowers and tasty vegetables with enough water and sunshine!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to take out a full bag of household trash"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: You do this once the bin at home gets completely full.
quests.explanation: That's right! Emptying the trash means carrying a full bag outside.
quests.funFact: Many neighborhoods have a special collection day just for household trash!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to pack comfy clothes for an active class at school"?
quests.question: Pack Your Gym Clothes
quests.hint: You wear these for an active class, not for regular lessons.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing gym clothes means bringing comfy sneakers and clothes for exercise.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right gym clothes can make exercise class much more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to help outdoor flowers and veggies grow big and healthy"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: Flowers and vegetables both benefit from this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A well-watered garden grows healthy flowers and vegetables.
quests.funFact: Watering a garden in the cool of the evening helps plants soak up water before the hot sun returns!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to replace a full bag with a fresh, empty one"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: This keeps the whole house smelling clean and fresh.
quests.explanation: Well done! Emptying the trash helps keep our whole home clean and fresh.
quests.funFact: Taking out the trash regularly helps keep germs and odors away from your home!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to clean the carpet with a humming machine"?
quests.question: Vacuum the Floor
quests.hint: It works on carpets and rugs, not hard floors.
quests.explanation: That's right! Vacuuming means using a machine to clean a carpet or rug.
quests.funFact: Vacuuming regularly can help keep dust from building up around your home!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to sort a pile of socks into matching pairs"?
quests.question: Match Your Socks
quests.hint: Stripes, spots, or plain colors help you find the matching pair.
quests.explanation: Well done! Matched socks are ready to be folded and put away.
quests.funFact: Matching socks is like a fun little puzzle you solve with clean laundry!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to pull dust and crumbs out of the rug"?
quests.question: Vacuum the Floor
quests.hint: Dust and crumbs disappear inside this machine.
quests.explanation: Well done! A vacuumed carpet feels fresh and looks spotless.
quests.funFact: The very first vacuum cleaners were much bigger and louder than the ones we use today!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to bring sneakers and comfy clothes for exercise class"?
quests.question: Pack Your Gym Clothes
quests.hint: This outfit needs to be easy to run and jump in.
quests.explanation: Well done! The right gym clothes make it easy to run, jump, and play.
quests.funFact: Comfy sneakers help protect your feet while you run, jump, and play games at school!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to share kind words after a family meal"?
quests.question: Say Thank You for Dinner
quests.hint: These kind words show you appreciate the meal someone made.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying thank you is a kind way to end a family meal.
quests.funFact: Saying thank you is a simple habit that can make the people around you feel appreciated!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to make everything dark and quiet for bedtime"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: Your room becomes dark and cozy right after this happens.
quests.explanation: That's right! Turning off the light helps our room get dark for bedtime.
quests.funFact: Some children like a soft night light to keep a little glow in the dark!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to get comfy and drift off to sleep"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: This is the very last thing you do before you fall asleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Going to bed helps us get the sleep we need.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to splash away sleepy eyes with cool water"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You gently pat dry with a towel once you finish this.
quests.explanation: Correct! Washing our face is one of the first things we do each morning.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to step outside and head toward your classroom"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You use your own two feet for this journey.
quests.explanation: Yes! We walk to school in the morning to get to our classroom.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to secure your shoes with a careful knot"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: Two loops crossed together make the knot for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tie our shoelaces so our shoes stay snug on our feet.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie your own shoelaces is a proud step toward getting ready all by yourself!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Anytime to keep your body cool and full of energy"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: A cup or a bottle helps you do this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We drink water to keep our body cool and full of energy.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to enjoy a calm story before bedtime"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: This is a calm, quiet activity, often done before bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Reading a story is a calm way to end the day.
quests.funFact: Some children love hearing the very same favorite story again and again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to greet everyone with a happy, friendly hello"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: A smile often comes along with these friendly words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good morning is a cheerful way to start the day.
quests.funFact: People around the world greet each other every morning in their own special way!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to return your playthings to their proper shelf or bin"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: You do this once playtime is completely finished.
quests.explanation: That's right! Putting away toys means placing each one back where it belongs.
quests.funFact: Giving every toy its own special spot makes clean-up time much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to gather your homework and supplies for the day"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: Books, pencils, and homework all go inside this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our backpack in the morning so we're ready for school.
quests.funFact: A backpack with both straps on your shoulders is comfier to carry all day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to prepare a meal to eat later at school"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: Sandwiches, fruit, or crackers might go inside for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed lunch means you're ready for a tasty midday meal.
quests.funFact: Some children like to pack their own lunch and choose their favorite foods!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to bring along a small treat for later in the day"?
quests.question: Pack a Snack
quests.hint: You eat this later, between breakfast and lunch or after school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing a snack means bringing a small bite for later.
quests.funFact: A small packed snack can be just the boost you need in the middle of a busy day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to put away what you wore so your room stays neat"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: This keeps your clothes neat instead of scattered on the floor.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up clothes means using a hook or hanger to store them.
quests.funFact: A tidy closet makes it much easier to pick an outfit in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning and Night for a fresh, sparkly smile"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You use a small brush and a dab of toothpaste for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We brush our teeth in the morning and at night to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!
